brand_identity.name: MyAibo
brand_identity.vibe: Boutique AI + Marketing Agency. Expensive, cinematic, moody, and highly technical yet elegant.

hero_background.description: Cinematic server room/art gallery fusion. Use in the Hero section as an absolute background layer with a heavy overlay (e.g., bg-[#0F0A1E]/80 or radial gradient) so text remains ultra-legible.

tech_services_background.description: Abstract glowing neural network. Use in the Technology Services section behind the stats strip. Blend mode 'screen' or opacity 20%.

process_background.description: Moody luxury workspace. Good for the Process section or Testimonials background to give depth.

texture_overlay.description: Abstract fluid purple texture. Can be used as a subtle noise/gradient mix inside cards or footer.

sections_architecture.name: Navigation Bar
sections_architecture.rules: Fixed top, z-50. Glassmorphism surface. Left: Logo. Center/Right: Links. Includes a 'Solutions' dropdown using Shadcn NavigationMenu or DropdownMenu with 7 requested sub-items. Must be fully responsive with a hamburger menu for mobile.

sections_architecture.name: Hero Section
sections_architecture.rules: Full height (min-h-screen). Background: 'hero_background' with heavy gradient overlay to ensure text contrast. Top: Pulsing badge (border border-[#7C3BED] with inner glow). Headline: Massive Fraunces H1. Dual CTAs (Primary solid #7C3BED, Secondary outlined).

sections_architecture.name: Dual Pillar Positioning
sections_architecture.rules: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2. Left: Marketing (warm/human emphasis). Right: Technology (cold/precision emphasis). High contrast between the two halves. Use border-r border-white/10 on desktop to split them.

sections_architecture.name: Marketing Services
sections_architecture.rules: 4-card grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2). Cards must use 'glass_card' surface and 'glow_card_hover' effects. Include Phosphor or Lucide icons for each service.

sections_architecture.name: Technology Services
sections_architecture.rules: Full width. Background color #080510 with 'tech_services_background' overlay at low opacity. Highlight massive numbers using Fraunces, emphasizing engineering scale.

sections_architecture.name: Why MyAibo
sections_architecture.rules: 3x2 grid. Container has border-collapse look. Items have border-r and border-b in rgba(255,255,255,0.1). Minimal padding, stark 'Swiss' high-contrast layout applied to dark mode.

sections_architecture.name: Results / Proof Numbers
sections_architecture.rules: Two massive panels side by side. Huge typography. One panel accented with primary #7C3BED background and white text, the other dark #1A1333 with purple text.

sections_architecture.name: Case Studies
sections_architecture.rules: Top: Filter pills (using Shadcn Tabs or custom horizontal scrolling pills). Bottom: Grid of work. Since images are placeholders, use dark colored blocks with the 'texture_overlay' as a placeholder graphic.

sections_architecture.name: Process
sections_architecture.rules: Horizontal scrolling or flex-row setup. Use 'process_background' at 10% opacity. A connecting thin line (border-t border-white/20) with glowing nodes for each step.

sections_architecture.name: Testimonials
sections_architecture.rules: Neumorphic tactile variant adapted for dark mode. Cards with subtle light top inner border, deep ambient shadow. Quote marks in huge Fraunces typography.

sections_architecture.name: Final CTA
sections_architecture.rules: Centered. 'Ready to scale?' H2. Links to Outlook booking url. Use a glowing primary button for the main action.

sections_architecture.name: Footer
sections_architecture.rules: py-24. Background #080510. Top section: Newsletter subscribe (Static UI - Input + Button). Bottom: Links and huge 'MyAibo' watermark logo.

components_instructions.dropdown: Use Shadcn UI DropdownMenu or NavigationMenu for the Solutions dropdown.
components_instructions.buttons: Standardize on an elegant pill shape (rounded-full) or sharp rectangle (rounded-md) depending on the 'Jewel' vs 'Tech' balance. Let's go with rounded-full for a boutique feel. Primary button: bg-[#7C3BED] hover:bg-[#9A64F0] text-white. Secondary: bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10.
components_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react. Ensure stroke-width is 1.5 for a premium, delicate look.
components_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-solutions-dropdown', data-testid='hero-cta-button').

critical_rules: NEVER use pure black #000000. Use #0F0A1E or #080510.
NEVER use Inter. Use Fraunces for headings and DM Sans for body.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; apply backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent color.
Always check contrast ratios. The dark theme requires white or very light gray text for body copy.
No placeholder URLs for images. Use the media_urls provided in this JSON.
Provide a smooth scrolling experience (can simulate with CSS scroll-behavior: smooth).
